**Academic Integrity Statement**
Please describe any extra help you received on this assignment. Getting help is okay!
If you did this work completely on your own, type "I did this work on my own."
If you got help from anyone or anywhere else, describe it here following the [Computer Science assistance policy](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1KCmAOijnNBKLN8nssC6Z-ZnyAD5p1x_fqTyPs0WIyNA/edit?usp=sharing).
